title: Housing the Next Billion: A Practitioner's Handbook

revision_note: November 7 reviewer revision: conditional diagnosis-first thesis, six-part structure, revised chapter links and conclusion, enabling-markets lineage, TOKI record and illustrative route comparison. Remaining source and evidence qualifications are explicit. Ghana trial citations consolidated under R222; duplicate R212 removed. Removed the requested public-construction sentence. Opening, introduction and conclusion sharpened to prioritise land, services and finance, with direct building conditional on well-located public land and delivery capacity. Whole-book consistency revision: 44 targeted paragraph edits across all 16 chapters apply land, services and household finance to practical decisions and transfer lessons. Evidence and direct-building qualifications retained; 318 pages, cover and design preserved. Bottom-50-percent revision: 51 targeted paragraph edits define the lower half of the income distribution and apply it across all 16 chapters and eight appraisal tests, with separate attention to the poorest households. Source-specific income groups and programme rules retained. Includes 23 bold-summary formatting fixes; cover, design and 318-page pagination preserved.
